label: Sample data: fictional endpoints, departments and results for demonstration only

check.name: Ensure SMBv1 is disabled.
check.remediation: Set the 'SMB1' registry value to 0 and restart the Server service.
check.rationale: SMBv1 is outdated and has known remote-code-execution vulnerabilities.
check.description: SMBv1 should be disabled on every endpoint. The recommended state for this setting is: Disabled.

check.name: Ensure minimum password length is 14 or more characters.
check.remediation: Set 'Minimum password length' to 14 or more in the local or domain password policy.
check.rationale: Short passwords are easier to guess or brute force.
check.description: Defines the fewest characters a password may contain. The recommended state for this setting is: 14 or more character(s).

check.name: Ensure the host firewall is enabled for all profiles.
check.remediation: Enable Windows Defender Firewall for the Domain, Private and Public profiles.
check.rationale: A host firewall limits network exposure of local services.
check.description: The recommended state for this setting is: On (recommended).

check.name: Ensure the Telnet client is not installed.
check.reason: Sample: feature query returned no data on this endpoint.
check.remediation: Remove the Telnet client optional feature.
check.rationale: Telnet sends credentials in clear text.
check.description: Telnet should not be installed.

check.name: Ensure screen lock activates after 15 minutes or less.
check.remediation: Set the machine inactivity limit to 900 seconds or fewer.
check.rationale: Locks unattended sessions.
check.description: The recommended state for this setting is: 900 or fewer second(s), but not 0.

check.name: Ensure the Guest account is disabled.
check.remediation: Disable the built-in Guest account.
check.rationale: The Guest account allows unauthenticated local access.
check.description: The recommended state for this setting is: Disabled.
